# Progress Texas

> Progress Texas is a grassroots political organization empowering supporters to manage their engagement and account preferences through a self-service portal.

Progress Texas provides tools for supporters to maintain control over their communications, subscriptions, and account settings. The organization focuses on enabling direct supporter participation in progressive causes across Texas.

## Key Topics

- account management
- self-service portal
- email subscriptions
- supporter preferences
- account access
- contact information
- preference management

## Account & Preferences

- [Manage your preferences](https://act.progresstexas.org/a/self-service): Self-service portal for Progress Texas supporters to manage account preferences and subscriptions
